items.source: MongoTransactionManager / ReactiveMongoTransactionManager is the gateway to the well known Spring transaction support. It lets applications use the managed transaction features of Spring. The MongoTransactionManager binds a ClientSession to the thread whereas the ReactiveMongoTransactionManager is using the ReactorContext for this. MongoTemplate detects the session and operates on these resources which are associated with the transaction accordingly. MongoTemplate can also participate in other, ongoing transactions. The following example shows how to create and use transactions with a MongoTransactionManager:

items.source: MongoDB count operates upon collection statistics which may not reflect the actual situation within a transaction. The server responds with error 50851 when issuing a count command inside a multi-document transaction. Once MongoTemplate detects an active transaction, all exposed count() methods are converted and delegated to the aggregation framework using $match and $count operators, preserving Query settings, such as collation.
items.translation:
MongoDB 的 `count` 操作基于集合统计信息，这些信息可能无法反映事务内的实际情况。  
当在多文档事务中发出 `count` 命令时，服务器会返回错误 50851。  
一旦 `MongoTemplate` 检测到活动事务，所有暴露的 `count()` 方法都会被转换并委托给聚合框架，使用 `$match` 和 `$count` 运算符，同时保留 `Query` 设置（如 `collation`）。

items.source: Both MongoOperations and ReactiveMongoOperations provide gateway methods for tying a ClientSession to the operations. MongoCollection and MongoDatabase use session proxy objects that implement MongoDB’s collection and database interfaces, so you need not add a session on each call. This means that a potential call to MongoCollection#find() is delegated to MongoCollection#find(ClientSession).
items.translation:
`MongoOperations` 和 `ReactiveMongoOperations` 均提供了将 `ClientSession` 绑定到操作的方法。  
`MongoCollection` 和 `MongoDatabase` 使用实现了 MongoDB 集合和数据库接口的会话代理对象，因此无需在每次调用时显式添加会话。  
这意味着对 `MongoCollection#find()` 的潜在调用会被委托给 `MongoCollection#find(ClientSession)`。

items.source: Queries using Criteria.near(…) and Criteria.nearSphere(…) must be rewritten to Criteria.within(…) respective Criteria.withinSphere(…). Same applies for the near query keyword in repository query methods that must be changed to within. See also MongoDB JIRA ticket DRIVERS-518 for further reference.
items.translation: 使用 `Criteria.near(…)` 和 `Criteria.nearSphere(…)` 的查询必须重写为 `Criteria.within(…)` 或相应的 `Criteria.withinSphere(…)`。 此规则同样适用于仓库查询方法中的 `near` 查询关键字，需将其更改为 `within`。 有关更多信息，请参阅 MongoDB JIRA 工单 DRIVERS-518。

items.source: By using a Publisher that provides the actual session, you can defer session acquisition to the point of actual subscription. Still, you need to close the session when done, so as to not pollute the server with stale sessions. Use the doFinally hook on execute to call ClientSession#close() when you no longer need the session. If you prefer having more control over the session itself, you can obtain the ClientSession through the driver and provide it through a Supplier.
items.translation: 通过使用提供实际会话的 Publisher，您可以将会话获取推迟到实际订阅时。 不过，在使用完毕后仍需关闭会话，以免服务器中残留过期的会话。 请使用 execute 上的 doFinally 钩子来调用 ClientSession#close()，以在不再需要会话时关闭它。 如果您希望对会话本身拥有更多控制权，可以通过驱动程序获取 ClientSession，并通过一个 Supplier 提供它。

items.source: By default, the label namespace using the mongo: prefix is evaluated by MongoTransactionOptionsResolver that is configured by default. Transaction labels are provided by TransactionAttribute and available to programmatic transaction control through TransactionTemplate and TransactionalOperator. Due to their declarative nature, @Transactional(label = …) provides a good starting point that also can serve as documentation.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用 `mongo:` 前缀的标签命名空间由默认配置的 `MongoTransactionOptionsResolver` 进行评估。 事务标签由 `TransactionAttribute`》提供，并通过 `TransactionTemplate`》和 `TransactionalOperator`》用于程序化事务控制。 由于其声明式特性，`@Transactional(label = …)` 提供了一个良好的起点，同时也可以作为文档使用。

items.source: As of version 3.6, MongoDB supports the concept of sessions. The use of sessions enables MongoDB’s Causal Consistency model, which guarantees running operations in an order that respects their causal relationships. Those are split into ServerSession instances and ClientSession instances. In this section, when we speak of a session, we refer to ClientSession.
items.translation: 从版本 3.6 开始，MongoDB 支持会话的概念。 使用会话可以启用 MongoDB 的因果一致性模型，该模型保证操作按照尊重其因果关系的方式运行。 这些会话分为 ServerSession 实例和 ClientSession 实例。 在本节中，当我们提到会话时，指的是 ClientSession。

items.source: As of version 4, MongoDB supports Transactions. Transactions are built on top of Sessions and, consequently, require an active ClientSession.
items.translation: 从版本 4 开始，MongoDB 支持事务。 事务构建在会话之上，因此需要一个活跃的ClientSession。

items.source: The culprit of the above operation is in keeping the main flows DeleteResult instead of the transaction outcome published via either commitTransaction() or abortTransaction(), which leads to a rather complicated setup.
items.translation: 上述操作的罪魁祸首在于保留了主流程中的 `DeleteResult`，而不是通过 `commitTransaction()` 或 `abortTransaction()` 发布事务结果，这导致了一个相当复杂的设置。

items.source: MongoDB can add special labels to errors raised during transactional operations. Those may indicate transient failures that might vanish by merely retrying the operation. We highly recommend Spring Retry for those purposes. Nevertheless, one may override MongoTransactionManager#doCommit(MongoTransactionObject) to implement a Retry Commit Operation behavior as outlined in the MongoDB reference manual.
items.translation: MongoDB 可以在事务操作期间抛出的错误上添加特殊标签。这些标签可能表示瞬态失败，仅通过重试操作即可消除。我们强烈建议为此目的使用 Spring Retry。尽管如此，也可以重写 MongoTransactionManager#doCommit(MongoTransactionObject) 来实现 MongoDB 参考手册中概述的 重试提交操作 行为。

items.source: The preceding example lets you have full control over transactional behavior while using the session scoped MongoOperations instance within the callback to ensure the session is passed on to every server call. To avoid some of the overhead that comes with this approach, you can use a TransactionTemplate to take away some of the noise of manual transaction flow.
items.translation: 前面的示例让您在使用会话范围的 `MongoOperations` 实例时能够完全控制事务行为，同时确保在回调中将会话传递给每个服务器调用。 为避免这种方法带来的一些开销，您可以使用 `TransactionTemplate` 来简化手动事务流程中的繁琐操作。

items.source: Spring Data MongoDB transactions support both TransactionTemplate and TransactionalOperator.
items.translation: Spring Data MongoDB 的事务支持同时涵盖 `TransactionTemplate` 和 `TransactionalOperator`。

items.source: To get full programmatic control over transactions, you may want to use the session callback on MongoOperations.
items.translation: 若要实现对事务的完全程序化控制，您可能希望使用 MongoOperations 上的会话回调。

items.source: Transactional service methods can require specific transaction options to run a transaction. Spring Data MongoDB’s transaction managers support evaluation of transaction labels such as @Transactional(label = { "mongo:readConcern=available" }).
items.translation: 事务服务方法可能需要特定的事务选项来运行事务。Spring Data MongoDB 的事务管理器支持评估事务标签，例如 `@Transactional(label = { "mongo:readConcern=available" })`。

items.source: Controls the maximum execution time on the server for the commitTransaction operation. The format of the value corresponds with ISO-8601 duration format as used with Duration.parse(…).
items.translation: 控制服务器上 `commitTransaction` 操作的最大执行时间。 该值的格式对应于 `Duration.parse(…)` 中使用的 ISO-8601 持续时间格式。

items.source: 1 First we obviously need to initiate the session. 2 Once we have the ClientSession at hand, start the transaction. 3 Operate within the transaction by passing on the ClientSession to the operation. 4 If the operations completes exceptionally, we need to stop the transaction and preserve the error. 5 Or of course, commit the changes in case of success. Still preserving the operations result. 6 Lastly, we need to make sure to close the session.
items.translation: 1 首先，我们显然需要启动会话。 2 一旦手头有了 ClientSession，就开始事务。 3 通过将 ClientSession 传递给操作，在事务内执行操作。 4 如果操作异常完成，我们需要中止事务并保留错误信息。 5 或者当然，在成功时提交更改。 同时保留操作结果。 6 最后，我们需要确保关闭会话。

items.source: Methods such as (Reactive)MongoOperations#getCollection return native MongoDB Java Driver gateway objects (such as MongoCollection) that themselves offer dedicated methods for ClientSession. These methods are NOT session-proxied. You should provide the ClientSession where needed when interacting directly with a MongoCollection or MongoDatabase and not through one of the #execute callbacks on MongoOperations.

items.translation: 在处理 DBRef 实例（尤其是懒加载的实例）时，务必在所有数据加载完成之前不要关闭 ClientSession。否则，懒加载将失败。

items.source: Unless you specify a MongoTransactionManager within your application context, transaction support is DISABLED. You can use setSessionSynchronization(ALWAYS) to participate in ongoing non-native MongoDB transactions.
items.translation: 除非在应用程序上下文中指定了 MongoTransactionManager，否则事务支持处于禁用状态。 您可以使用 setSessionSynchronization(ALWAYS) 来参与正在进行的非原生 MongoDB 事务。

items.source: Unless you specify a ReactiveMongoTransactionManager within your application context, transaction support is DISABLED. You can use setSessionSynchronization(ALWAYS) to participate in ongoing non-native MongoDB transactions.
items.translation: 除非在您的应用程序上下文中指定了 ReactiveMongoTransactionManager，否则事务支持处于禁用状态。 您可以使用 setSessionSynchronization(ALWAYS) 来参与正在进行的非原生 MongoDB 事务。

items.source: @Transactional(readOnly = true) advises MongoTransactionManager to also start a transaction that adds the ClientSession to outgoing requests.
items.translation: @Transactional(readOnly = true) 会建议 MongoTransactionManager 启动一个事务，并将 ClientSession 添加到出站请求中。

items.source: @Transactional(readOnly = true) advises ReactiveMongoTransactionManager to also start a transaction that adds the ClientSession to outgoing requests.
items.translation: @Transactional(readOnly = true) 会建议 ReactiveMongoTransactionManager 启动一个事务，并将 ClientSession 添加到出站请求中。

items.source: Make sure to add replicaSet to the MongoDB URI. Please refer to connection string options for further details.
items.translation: 请确保在 MongoDB URI 中添加 replicaSet。 有关详细信息，请参阅连接字符串选项。

items.source: Reactive use of ClientSession is limited to Template API usage. There’s currently no session integration with reactive repositories.
items.translation: 对 ClientSession 的反应式使用仅限于模板 API。 目前尚未实现与反应式存储库的会话集成。

items.source: Changing state of MongoTemplate during runtime (as you might think would be possible in item 1 of the preceding listing) can cause threading and visibility issues.
items.translation: 在运行时更改 MongoTemplate 的状态（正如您可能会认为在上一列表的第 1 项中那样可行）可能会导致线程和可见性问题。

items.source: Operations within a client session are not isolated from operations outside the session.
items.translation: 客户端会话内的操作与会话外的操作之间不存在隔离。

items.source: Nested transactions that join the outer transaction do not affect the initial transaction options as the transaction is already started. Transaction options are only applied when a new transaction is started.
items.translation: 与外部事务关联的嵌套事务不会影响初始的事务选项，因为该事务已经启动。 事务选项仅在启动新事务时才会应用。
